raw_response:
I will keep most of my land in the wheat-maize rotation because that is the most reliable way for me to secure grain and use my well water efficiently on only 3 mu. Since some family labor is away working off-farm, I will not make the plan too complicated or too labor-heavy. I will put 2 mu into winter wheat followed by summer maize on the same land, and I will keep 1 mu in cotton because I already grow it and I want some cash income alongside grain. For wheat, I will use improved seed, moderate fertilizer, two irrigations, and rotary tillage because it fits my conditions and keeps work manageable. For maize after wheat, I will use hybrid seed and no-tillage to save time and keep the season tight after wheat harvest. For cotton, I will use hybrid seed, a bit more potassium, more pest control, and three irrigations because cotton needs closer management but can still bring me cash from a small area.
